rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a bend or curve in a road.

example.english: The bend ahead is very sharp, so drive carefully.
example.traditional: 前面個彎位好急，小心啲揸車。
example.jyutping: cin4 min6 go3 waan1 wai2 hou2 gap1 siu2 sam1 di1 zaa1 ce1

rows.note: Use 屈 as the all-purpose verb when someone actively bends a physical object.

example.jyutping: nei5 bong1 ngo5 wat1 ni1 tiu4 tit3 sin3

rows.note: Use 彎 when something becomes curved or is described as having curved.

example.english: It is easy to bend this wire.
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 tit3 sin3 hou2 jung4 ji6 waan1

rows.note: Use 彎低 when a person stoops or bends down, especially to reach something.

example.english: I bend down to pick up my phone.
example.jyutping: ngo5 waan1 dai1 san1 zap1 faan1 bou6 din6 waa2

rows.note: Use 轉彎 for a person, vehicle, or road changing direction; a causer is normally expressed with 叫 or 令.

example.jyutping: cin4 min6 tiu4 lou6 wui5 zyun2 waan1

rows.note: Use this medical term specifically for decompression sickness in divers.

example.english: The doctor said it was decompression sickness, not something caused by the bend underwater.
example.traditional: 醫生話佢係減壓病，唔係水底彎位造成嘅。
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 keoi5 hai6 gaam2 aat3 beng6 m4 hai6 seoi2 dai2 waan1 wai2 zou6 sing4 ge3

rows.note: Use this technical guitar term for bending a string to glide up in pitch.

example.english: You need to bend the string in this solo for the pitch to rise.
example.traditional: 呢段獨奏要用推弦，個音先會升上去。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 duk6 zau3 jiu3 jung6 teoi1 jin4 go3 jam1 sin1 wui5 sing1 soeng5 heoi3
